Zhipu AI.why: Chinese foundation-model developer (GLM series, z.ai) whose revenue now comes mainly from per-invocation API / MaaS and coding-plan sales of its GLM models, run on a cluster of over 100,000 domestic chips; its stock rises and falls with GLM model usage.
Zhipu AI.evidence: Z.AI Co., Ltd. (formerly Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited) ... principally engaged in the provision of large model-related services. ... Revenue from the Open Platform and API, or cloud services provided by the Group based on general-purpose large models, increased from RMB29.1 million ... to RMB825.2 million.

players.product: GLM foundation models (GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash) served through the z.ai open platform / API (GLM MaaS), GLM Coding Plan subscriptions and on-premise deployment

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 interim results (six months ended June 30, 2026): revenue RMB953.9 million vs RMB190.9 million a year earlier, up 399.7%, driven by the explosive growth of cloud-based deployment; gross profit RMB251.6 million (+163.7%), but gross margin fell from 50.0% to 26.4% because the still-ramping cloud business grew as a share of the mix; R&D expenses RMB2,131.2 million (+33.6%) on continued model-training investment; loss for the period RMB2,072.0 million vs RMB2,357.9 million (-12.1%); adjusted net loss (non-IFRS) RMB1,964,138 thousand vs RMB1,751,974 thousand. Cost of sales rose 635.4% to RMB702.3 million, mainly higher computing service fees from business expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB953.9 million (+399.7%); gross profit RMB251.6 million (+163.7%), margin 50.0% to 26.4%; R&D RMB2,131.2 million (+33.6%); loss RMB2,072.0 million (-12.1%); cost of sales RMB702.3 million (+635.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Revenue mix flipped to per-invocation API: open platform and API (cloud-based deployment) revenue RMB825.2 million, up 2,735.7%, 86.5% of revenue vs 15.2% a year earlier; on-premise deployment revenue fell 20.5% to RMB128.7 million (enterprise-level general-purpose large models RMB67.0 million, -54.6%; enterprise-level agents RMB55.6 million, +304.4%); technical services and others RMB6.1 million. Management: the API share rose from 26.3% of the previous full year to 86.5% while on-premises model deployment fell from 73.7% to 13.5%, 'essentially an inevitable consequence of a generational leap in model capability'; the coding direction became the primary revenue source; the company proactively scaled back on-premise licensing and some on-premise customers migrated to the API.
quarterly_data.figure: open platform and API RMB825.2 million (+2,735.7%), 86.5% of revenue (15.2% a year earlier); on-premise RMB128.7 million (-20.5%); enterprise agents RMB55.6 million (+304.4%); general-purpose large models RMB67.0 million (-54.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Margins by business: open platform and API gross profit RMB202.9 million, gross margin improved from -0.4% to 24.6% (up approximately 6 percentage points from 2025), attributed to economies of scale as Token usage diluted fixed costs, upward pricing adjustments and full-stack engineering optimization that cut inference costs; on-premise deployment gross margin fell from 59.1% to 37.9%; enterprise-level agents gross margin fell from 64.6% to 35.6% on heavy delivery costs, which the company expects to stabilize and recover as economies of scale emerge.
quarterly_data.figure: API gross profit RMB202.9 million, margin -0.4% to 24.6%; on-premise margin 59.1% to 37.9%; agents margin 64.6% to 35.6%

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Volumes and prices both up (as of the announcement date): MaaS platform Token invocation volume up over 40 times from the beginning of 2026 and Coding Plan invocation volume up over 23 times, while the average API selling price increased by approximately 101% and Coding Plan subscription prices also went up. GLM MaaS platform enterprise and developer users exceeded 5.8 million at June 30, 2026 and over 7.4 million at the announcement date (up 144% from the beginning of 2026); paid daily active users up 603%; the top ten customers' average daily invocation volume up 98 times. The company's compute multiplier (open platform and API revenue per RMB1 of training plus inference computing investment) rose approximately 14 times year-on-year.
quarterly_data.figure: Token volume over 40 times; average API price up approximately 101%; users over 7.4 million (+144%); paid DAU +603%; top-ten customer invocation 98 times; compute multiplier approximately 14 times

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Compute supply: since the beginning of 2026 the company has run an All-in-Infra strategy, investing in both training and inference and integrating domestic chips as a primary inference compute resource; it has achieved large-scale, low-cost inference across a cluster of over 100,000 domestic chips, with unit Token inference costs down 80% from the beginning of the year. Company: 'Given the persistent global supply constraints on compute, this path ensures that the Company's cost curve remains within its own control.' It relies on third parties for computing resources (prepayments for computing service fee and others RMB1,243,736 thousand and payables for computing service fees RMB1,427,415 thousand at June 30, 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: over 100,000 domestic chips; unit Token inference cost down 80%

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GLM-5.3-Flash inference is the first time the company fully deployed a domestic chip cluster to serve ultra-large-scale real-world traffic, with chips interconnected via a self-developed high-bandwidth network; a dedicated inference engine built on SGLang with an Encode-Prefill-Decode disaggregated architecture tripled end-to-end service performance versus the initial baseline on the same hardware (a 300% improvement), and in coding scenarios the per-Token inference cost on domestic chips reached cost-performance comparable to mainstream imported GPUs. Company: the main technical constraint is the memory capacity and bandwidth of domestic chips, making 1M context support particularly challenging; 'Domestic chips can economically support inference for cutting-edge models at large scale.'
quarterly_data.figure: end-to-end service performance tripled (300% improvement) on domestic chips

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In August 2026 the company released GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash (Ox-Alpha) and opened the GLM Coding Plan subscription to all users (Lite, Pro, Max and Team editions). GLM-5.3 keeps GLM-5.2's architecture and parameter counts with scaled-up post-training; in the company's own coding evaluation its end-to-end completion rate improved by over 50% vs GLM-5.2. GLM-5.3-Flash is a new architecture with 320B total parameters, 18B active parameters and 45 layers (hybrid sparse and linear attention, 30T-scale multimodal pre-training corpus) and outperforms GLM-5.2 at one-tenth of its price; tested anonymously as Ox-Alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter, it logged a 6-day cumulative Token volume of more than 62 trillion (company-reported).
quarterly_data.figure: GLM-5.3-Flash: 320B total / 18B active parameters, 45 layers; one-tenth of GLM-5.2's price; GLM-5.3 completion rate over 50% higher

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Model cadence and capability (company-reported): the GLM series completed six iterations (4.6, 4.7, 5, 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3) over approximately 11 months, with per-task costs stable at around USD0.20 and GLM-5.3-Flash at USD0.045 per task (citing the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index); its model scored 84.5% on CyberGym and completed 130 tasks on ExploitGym; red-team work since GLM-5.2 identified 2,436 vulnerabilities, 1,097 of them medium- or high-severity. Outlook: the company is advancing training of its next-generation base model, targeting larger effective scale, longer native context and unified native multimodal modelling, and aims to move from hour-scale engineering tasks to day-scale delivery and multi-agent business processes.
quarterly_data.figure: six GLM iterations in approximately 11 months; per-task cost around USD0.20 (GLM-5.3-Flash USD0.045)

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure rose to RMB390.6 million from RMB53.7 million (+627.4%), primarily because the company completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest of Beijing Hongzuan Technology Development Co., Ltd. in May 2026, adding a significant amount of property, plant and equipment; in June 2026 it also completed the acquisition of a 60% equity interest in Beijing XCore Sigma Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., which is principally engaged in AI-infrastructure research and development.
